summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to 20 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, up 2 yen from previous guidance of 18 yen, reflecting upward revision of full-year earnings forecast with operating profit increased to 1.7 billion yen from 1.5 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Vega Corporation raised its annual dividend per share to 20 yen for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, up 2 yen from the previous guidance of 18 yen issued on May 15, 2026. The increase follows an upward revision of the full-year earnings forecast announced simultaneously with this dividend guidance. The company raised operating profit forecast to 1.7 billion yen from 1.5 billion yen, net income to 986 million yen from 921 million yen, and maintained sales guidance at 21.6 billion yen.

The earnings upgrade reflects strong progress through the second quarter, driven by five new store openings (bringing total store count to 18) and successful omnichannel initiatives combining direct-to-consumer e-commerce with physical retail. The company also achieved higher-than-expected gross profit margins through disciplined cost control using foreign exchange hedging to manage currency volatility.

The company operates under a dividend policy targeting either a payout ratio of 20 percent or dividend-on-equity of 2.0 percent, whichever is larger, while maintaining sufficient internal reserves for strengthening operational capacity and funding future growth investments. Second quarter dividend remains at zero yen, with the full-year 20 yen payout occurring at fiscal year-end.
